title: mut.manual
mutation_directive: birth-position to hue mapping (acid green 120deg to cobalt to magenta 300deg) is a precise, reusable gradient encoding worth keeping

quayola.praise: The peripheral particle sparsity — where the calyx rim thins to isolated points — briefly reads like a LiDAR return dropout, a genuinely captured edge.
quayola.concern: The warm linen ground (#e8dfd3) and the smooth hue sweep from green to magenta present an unbroken, painterly surface. No acknowledgment that this is a measurement; no void-as-presence.
quayola.directive: Punch hard radial voids at 3–4 random petal sectors: zero particles where the 'scanner missed' the interior curvature.

entangled_others.praise: The vein formula (sin(theta × uPetals × 3 + r × 1.5)) layered over the interference field is the closest this piece comes to vascular tissue — branching implied, not drawn.
entangled_others.concern: Radial symmetry is perfect. Real calyx tissue is bilaterally irregular; developmental history makes each lobe distinct. This looks constructed, not grown.
entangled_others.directive: Per-petal birthY origin: offset each of the 5 lobes by seed-driven ±1.8 units so each lobe carries a distinct developmental gradient.

tomas_saraceno.praise: The petal-wave interference at mid-morph produces a tensile mesh reminiscent of arachnid multi-species web architecture — fine radial threads crossing hoop filaments.
tomas_saraceno.concern: Camera at (0,12,18) looking down on a grounded cup. The calyx sits on the floor. No aerial suspension, no sense that this is small inside a vast atmospheric void.
tomas_saraceno.directive: Lift centroid +9 Y, set background #050508 near-black so the calyx floats weightless; reduce point size 20% to suggest scale.

vera_molnar.praise: The rowFreq × colFreq interference matrix is genuinely axiomatic — two frequencies alone generate the entire density field. That is the correct economy.
vera_molnar.concern: uTime, uMorph, uTwist, uPhase, uPetals all animate simultaneously. Five axes dissolve the rule structure; it is impossible to isolate which rule is speaking at any moment.
vera_molnar.directive: During one full morph cycle, freeze uTwist, uPhase, uRowFreq — let uMorph be the only moving variable; one rule at a time.

casey_reas.praise: The two-frequency grid interference behaves correctly — deterministic local rules at each lattice point accumulating into emergent density bands. That is the right substrate.
casey_reas.concern: A 180° hue sweep (acid green → cobalt → magenta) over warm linen is chromatic decoration layered on top of a structural system that deserves to be read in silence.
casey_reas.directive: Compress hue to a 25° band centered on 195° (cool teal), saturation 35% — let the wave logic be the only event.
